disclosure_limitations: This NRB file is promoted into frontend/public/data/companies/company_report_insights.json as a controlled public audit financial contract.
All reported amounts are stored as integer KRW won and no derived ratios are stored in the source JSON.
2026-03-18 business report standalone statements are the latest primary source for 2023, 2024, and 2025 values.
The 2024 operating cash flow difference is treated as a resolved K-IFRS 1008 retrospective cash-flow presentation policy change; the pre-policy-change amount is retained only as historical evidence.
The 2023 current-liability difference is treated as a resolved K-IFRS 1001 retrospective classification change for redeemable convertible preferred-share liabilities.
Consolidated statement values and subsidiary results are excluded from financial_years.
Standalone revenue breakdown is disclosed in thousand KRW and converted to integer KRW with a maximum 999 KRW rounding tolerance against income_statement.revenue.
The disclosed product, rental, service, construction, and other revenue labels are not interpreted as separate modular segment revenue without additional segment disclosure.
Goods revenue is not a disclosed NRB standalone revenue caption and remains not_applicable instead of being filled with zero.
Convertible bonds, bonds, derivative liabilities, and redeemable preferred-share liabilities are not added to the existing borrowings fields unless the schema definition is expanded in a later phase.
The existing public company card operating margin of 7.6% is reconciled to the audited standalone calculation of 7.5% through this public View Model and the NRB public company summary financials.

entity_attribution.attribution_warning: This staging file uses NRB standalone financial statements. Consolidated statements and subsidiary values are excluded from financial_years. Standalone revenue breakdown captions were cross-checked from notes 26.1 and 27.1, but product, rental, service, construction, and other revenue are not automatically treated as separate modular segment revenue. The 2024 operating cash flow and 2023 current-liability differences are documented as resolved retrospective presentation/classification changes.

special_events.description: 2023 감사보고서에는 한국채택국제회계기준 최초채택 강조사항이 포함되어 있다.

K-IFRS 1001 liability classification amendments were applied retrospectively. Redeemable convertible preferred-share liabilities that can be exercised within 12 months after the reporting period were classified as current liabilities. The 2023 current-liability amount after reclassification is 81,185,943,632 KRW; the pre-reclassification amount was 48,527,580,433 KRW and the reclassification effect was 32,658,363,199 KRW.

The 2026-03-18 business report note 2.2.1 explains that cash flows from modular fixed assets held for rental purposes were reclassified between operating and investing cash flows and applied retrospectively under K-IFRS 1008. The change affects only the cash-flow statement and does not affect the statement of financial position, income statement, or statement of changes in equity. For 2024, operating cash flow changed from -2,611,715 thousand KRW to 20,142,351 thousand KRW and investing cash flow changed from -2,956,754 thousand KRW to -25,710,820 thousand KRW.
2026 사업보고서의 연결재무제표와 종속기업 값은 별도재무 financial_years에서 제외한다.
